_about: Z15: zone quest script engine. Offsets are payload offsets (after the 2-byte opcode); layouts read in the 2016 zone code, names from the 2016 server PDB (pdb2016).

0x4403.name: NC_QUEST_DB_SET_INFO_REQ
fields: script command that caused it: 6 ACCEPT, 7 CANCEL, 8 PROGRESS, 9 FAILED, 12 ABORT, 28 REPEAT_QUEST_GIVE_UP
0x20: u16 ID, u8 Status, PLAYER_QUEST_DATA (StartTime i64, EndTime i64, RepeatCount u32, ProgressStep u8, End_NPCMobCount[5], flags u8, End_RunningTimeSec u16)

0x4405.name: NC_QUEST_DB_CLEAR_REQ
fields: only sent when the stale u32 at buffer+4 is non-zero (Z15-B9)

0x4406.name: NC_QUEST_DB_CLEAR_ACK
fields: must equal the current command's quest id

0x440b.name: NC_QUEST_CLIENT_SCENARIO_DONE_REQ
fields: checked off in every doing quest whose end condition is this scenario

0x440c.name: NC_QUEST_CLIENT_SCENARIO_DONE_ACK
fields: sent only when some doing quest was updated

0x441a.name: NC_QUEST_DB_DONE_REQ
0x441a.basis: zone FUN_005bbe60 (Send_NC_QUEST_DB_DONE_REQ); size 0x53 + n*0x26 + attribute bytes
fields: diary record after SetQuestDone: status 2 DONE / 4 REPEAT, RepeatCount+1, EndTime now
inventory lock index of the reservations

0x26 each: u32 owner, MAPPOS map (12-byte name + x, y), ITEM_INVEN location (9<<10|cell), u64 createitemregnum (key kind 2), u16 createitemid, u16 attr = payload offset of the item's attribute bytes after the array

0x441b.name: NC_QUEST_DB_DONE_ACK
fields: echo; sent to the client as 0x4401 Cmd

0x4411.name: NC_QUEST_REWARD_SELECT_ITEM_INDEX_CMD
fields: must equal the running script's quest
absolute Reward[] slot 0..11 (2017 client RewardWin::GetRealSelectReword); validated only at DONE

0x4412.name: NC_QUEST_REWARD_NEED_SELECT_ITEM_CMD
fields: client ignores it, shows 'Please choose reward(s).'

0x441e.name: NC_QUEST_RESET_TIME_CLIENT_CMD
fields: client stores all four at its CQuest+0xA4

0x4010.name: NC_CHARSAVE_2WLDMAN_QUEST_DONE_CMD
0x4010.basis: zone FUN_005bc6f0; chunked, at most 799 records per packet
